_approach: Production guides for Jersey Club note the groove is often described as triplet-based/tresillo-like even though the 5-kick skeleton is normally written on a straight 16th grid. This pattern approximates that triplet pull with swing 0.33 (the engine's closest straight mapping to a true 8th-note triplet subdivision) applied to the same 5-kick shape plus a rolling clave figure, giving the loose, rolling feel some krushclub flips lean into instead of the tighter straight version. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
